exercises_custom_owner.name: exercises_custom_owner
exercises_custom_owner.value: not "exercises"."is_custom" or "exercises"."created_by_trainer_id" is not null or "exercises"."archived_at" is not null

program_exercises_reps.name: program_exercises_reps
program_exercises_reps.value: "program_exercises"."target_reps_min" is null or "program_exercises"."target_reps_max" is null or "program_exercises"."target_reps_max" >= "program_exercises"."target_reps_min"

programs_assigned_has_start.name: programs_assigned_has_start
programs_assigned_has_start.value: "programs"."client_id" is null or "programs"."status" = 'draft' or "programs"."starts_on" is not null

programs_dates.name: programs_dates
programs_dates.value: "programs"."ends_on" is null or "programs"."starts_on" is null or "programs"."ends_on" >= "programs"."starts_on"

session_exercises_reps.name: session_exercises_reps
session_exercises_reps.value: "session_exercises"."target_reps_min" is null or "session_exercises"."target_reps_max" is null or "session_exercises"."target_reps_max" >= "session_exercises"."target_reps_min"

sessions_time_set.name: sessions_time_set
sessions_time_set.value: ("sessions"."scheduled_start" is null) = ("sessions"."scheduled_end" is null) and ("sessions"."scheduled_end" is null or "sessions"."scheduled_end" > "sessions"."scheduled_start")

set_logs_non_negative.name: set_logs_non_negative
set_logs_non_negative.value: coalesce("set_logs"."weight_kg", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("set_logs"."reps", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("set_logs"."duration_s", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("set_logs"."distance_m", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("set_logs"."level", 0) >= 0
